verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜਾਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal sach hai manmukh dhukh fal kooR kooRaavaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukh attains the pleasure fruit of truth and the manmukh receives the bitter fruit of falsehood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਪਛਾਵਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach sa(n)tokh rukh dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau pachhaavaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukh is tree of truth and contentment and the wicked person is the unstable shade of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੀ ਛਾਵਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach addol hai manmukh fer fira(n)dhee chhaavaa(n)|

en.bdb: Gurmukh is firm like truth and manmukh, the mind oriented is like ever shifting shade.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੋਇਲ ਅੰਬ ਵਣ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਾਂਵਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh koil a(n)b van manmukh van van ha(n)ddan kaa(n)vaa(n)|

en.bdb: Gurmukh is like nightingale which resides in mango groves but manmukh is like a crow which wanders in forests from place to place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਗ ਹੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੰਤੁ ਸਚਾਵਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sach baag hai sabadh surat gurma(n)t sachaavaa(n)|

en.bdb: The holy congregation is the true garden where gurmantr inspires the consciousness to merge in the Word, the true shade.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਹੁ ਵਣ ਵਲਿ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨਿਗੋਸਾਵਾਂ।
verses.translit_en: vih van val asaadh sa(n)g bahut siaanap nigosaavaa(n)|

en.bdb: Company of the wicked is like a wild poisonous creeper and the manmukh in order to develop it goes on playing many tricks.
He is like the son of a prostitute who goes without a family name.
